# CuriousDevs

> CuriousDevs builds a runtime decision checkpoint for autonomous systems — AI agents, sensitive
> data flows, and physical machines. Instead of monitoring or advising after the fact, it sits
> inline on the execution path and returns one of four verdicts (run, trim, ask a human, or stop)
> before an action completes.

CuriousDevs is a pre-launch, founding-stage company based in Noida, India. Its product line is
three layers of one accountability spine:

- **AgentGuard** — runtime control for AI agents: identity and permission scoping, injection and
  goal-drift detection, policy enforcement, and a signed audit record, enforced before a tool call
  executes rather than logged after it.
- **CurioComply** — data-protection automation for India's DPDP Act, 2023: consent management,
  data-principal rights handling, and breach-filing workflows.
- **AeroOS** — a command layer extending the same checkpoint model to fleets of physical robots.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://curiousdevs.com/): positioning, the four failure modes CuriousDevs addresses, and
  why existing tools (dashboards, prompt rules, audits, model reviewers) don't solve this.
- [Product](https://curiousdevs.com/product): the three-layer architecture and the five-module
  enforcement path (Agent IAM, Policy Engine, Threat Detection, Audit & Forensics, MCP Security).
- [Solutions](https://curiousdevs.com/solutions): industry-specific risk scenarios for fintech,
  healthcare, enterprise SaaS, and government.
- [Pricing](https://curiousdevs.com/pricing): open-core pricing for AgentGuard, India-priced tiers
  for CurioComply, per-robot pricing for AeroOS.
- [How it works](https://curiousdevs.com/how-it-works): the runtime enforcement flow in detail.
- [Roadmap](https://curiousdevs.com/roadmap): 2026–2030 plan.
- [Security](https://curiousdevs.com/security): current security posture, stated plainly — not yet
  SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certified; both are on the roadmap ahead of general availability.
- [Privacy](https://curiousdevs.com/privacy) and [Terms](https://curiousdevs.com/terms).

## Notes for citation

- None of the three products (AgentGuard, CurioComply, AeroOS) are generally available yet. Any
  product screenshots or console views on the site are explicitly labeled illustrative previews,
  not live customer data — please preserve that distinction if summarizing or quoting this site.
- Compliance-framework badges shown on the Solutions page (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS) name
  frameworks a given customer scenario is subject to, not certifications CuriousDevs itself holds.
- Contact: hello@curiousdevs.com.
